tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang bzhugs so:

man ngag nga drug pa: bya bral lhun rdzogs ngang la phyag 'tshal la ོ : rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang bskur bar 'dod pa yis: ri bo'i sul dben pa ru tshogs yo byad la sogs pa bshams: bye brag tu maṇḍal lnga bshams la: sngon du 'bru sna tshogs pa'i maṇḍal phul bas: bsod nams dang bde ba rgyas par byed: de nas me tog sna tshogs pa'i maṇḍal phul bas mkhyen pa'i shes rab lnga la longs spyo da : rin po che'i maṇḍal phul bas yon tan gyi chos zad mi shes pa la longs spyod: dri sna tshogs pa'i maṇḍal phul bas chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i gsung dbyangs dang ldan par 'gyur: sman sna tshogs pa'i maṇḍal phul bas phyi nang gi sdug bsngal las grol bar nges sa ོ : de nas bla mas kha shar du lta: slob mas kha nub tu bltas la: slob ma la dbang bskur bar bya ste: bla ma'i mdun du slob bu de lus bde lugs su 'dug shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu gdung ba'i sems kyis 'dug la: bla mas bu khyod su yin zhes dris pas: slob mas: bdag skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig lags: zhes lan gsum brjod par bya' ོ : de nas bla mas de'i lan du: de ltar yin phan chad sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ma myong ba'i dal 'di nyid du zhugs shig: ces brjod par bya' ོ : de nas bla ma la rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang zhu ba'i gsolab 'di ltar gdab par bya' ོ : kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid: bdag la rab tu dgongs su gsol: bdag ni khams gsum 'khor gnas su: yun ring gnas pas dran nyams te: 'khor ba nyid las brgal don du: bla ma la yang zhu bar bgyid: bskal pa brgya phrag du mar ni: bdag ni yang nas yang 'khor bas: rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes rang byung nyid: smad dang rtsa ba bcad pas sangs rgyas sems las byung : sems kyi dam pa bdag la bstan du gsol: zhes lan gsum brjod da ོ : de nas lus kyi cha bsrungs la thal mo sbyar la shes pa ma yengs par bla ma'i sems la gtad:

de nas glo bur du drag shul dang bcas pas sems gang yin: zhes lan gsum brjod pas slob ma'i rgyud la shes pa'i nyams 'di yin khas len dang bral ba tshad med pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sprul pa sku'i dal du zhugs te: slob mas seng ge lta bu'i 'dug stangs bya ste: shar gyi phyogs su kha bltas te yid la chos nyid skye ba med pa bsam zhing : bla mas 'di skad brjod: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na: yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba sku mdog mthing kha rin po che'i rgya na gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing rang rang gi 'khor la chos ston cing rang rang gis sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston ta ོ : bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la seng ge'i mchongs stabs kyis mchongs shig: a a a zhes rgyas btab la: yang kha lhor bltas la glang chen gyi 'dug stangs dang bstun la bla mas 'di skad brjod da ོ : e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod: lho phyogs na dpal dang ldan pa: zhes bya ba'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na: yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya ba sku mdog ser po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing rang rang gi 'khor la chos ston cing rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der seng ge'i stangs stabs kyis ltos la stag mo'i mchong stabs kyis mchongs shig

/ a a a zhes brjod par bya'o/ /yang nub tu bltas la drang srong gi 'dug stangs dang bstun nas bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma rigs kyi bu khyod nub phyogs padma brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba nyams dga' ba na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas zhes bya ba sku mdog dmar po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyon cing rang rang gi 'khor la chos ston cing rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal pa gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod dpal chen gyi rngam stabs kyis ltos la khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis song zhig /a a a zhes brjod do/ /yang byang du kha bltas la bya rgod kyi dpungs stangs dang bstun nas/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig khyod 'di nas byang phyogs na las rab yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba sku mdog ljang khu rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing rang rang gi 'khor la chos ston cing rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der rdo rje 'chang gi lta stangs gyi sa la glog dmar gyi 'gyu stangs kyis song zhig /a a a zhes brjod par bya 'o/ /sprul sku'i dal du 'jug go /yang slob ma rdo rje skyil krung du 'dug la/ longs sku'i dal du zhugs pa ste/ bla mas 'di ltar brjod par bya'o/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyon cig

/de dag thams cad las 'das pa'i pha rol na rgyan yongs su bkod pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams ye shes lngas khyab cing gsal bar rab tu mnyam zhing mi g.yo ba nyid na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba/ ye shes snang ba la kha lo bsgyur ba lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba/ 'khor yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brgya stong bye ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ sems nyid mngon par 'dus ma byas pa mngon par rol ba zhig yod kyis/ bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la seng ge'i mchong stangs kyis song zhig /a a a zhes brjod/ longs sku'i dal du 'jug pa' / ོ /de nas yang chos sku'i dal du 'jug ste/ seng ge'i gnad ba snu na du bcug la/ bla mas 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyon cig /de nas 'das pa'i pha rol na rang gi sems nyid bsam ngo dang bral zhing tshad med dpag tu med pa/ dmigs su med pa stong pa nyid gang du yang ma phye ba'i chos nyid bya ba bzhugs pas/ der bu khyod rig pa khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyi sa mtho sa ru sdod cig /drang srong gi 'dug stangs kyis drang por gnas par gyis shig / glang chen gyi nyal thabs kyis snyoms par nyol cig /lcags sdong gi 'dril stangs kyis kha bub la mtha' dril cig /skyes bu'i rgyangs thabs kyis gan rkyal du rgyongs shig /wa mo'i zur 'gros kyis klog la song zhig /bya rgod kyi dpungs stangs kyis sgur zlog gis spungs shig /gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ngal gsos la sa non cig /'bu srin gyi nur 'gros kyis dbyings rig la chags par gyis shig /stag mo'i mchongs stangs kyis nyams snang la rtsal sbyongs shig /g.yang mo'i sprug stangs kyis gzung 'dzin bag chags thams cad dus cig la ngo bo ru sprugs shig

/seng ge'i 'grengs tshugs kyi dbyings rig la sa zungs shig /sems ky-i bu sems nyid stong par gnas pas gzhi zungs shig /sems nyid rig stong du bstan pas gnad tshugs shig /sems nyid ma 'gags par 'gyu ba rtsal sbyongs shig /sems nyid ye shes su gsal bas lam sbyongs shig /sems nyid kun la khyab pas rtogs pa tshol cig /sems nyid cig car du myur pas la zlos shig /sems nyid sna tshogs ma 'dres pas shan phyes shig /sems nyid sna tshogs par 'phel bas ye shes las slar ma ldog cig /thig le las slar ma ldog cig /sku las slar ma ldog cig /de dag gis chos sku'i dal du 'jug pa'o/ /dal gsum du bcug nas/ /da gser gyi maṇḍal phul la/ sems nyid kyi ngo bor lha ngo bstan pa'i sems stong pa dang*/ rig pa lu gu rgyud du ngo sprad pa ni/ sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs rim pas bstun tu bcug la/ bla mas 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /e ma skal ldan dge ba'i sems kyi bu gcig po/ / 'gyu ba sems nyid ngo bo stong la rang bzhin ye shes lhag mthong gi don nyon cig /sems nyid bde stong 'gyu ba zung 'jug phyag rgya stong pa chen po'i gzhi ye shes rig la lngar bsgyur cig /sems nyid stong pa ye shes ma 'dres zang thal gyis ma rig pa snod bcud sol cig /sems blan nyid blo rim dang 'jug pa/ theg pa tha dad kyi mtha' nyag gcig tu thig le sdus shig /sems nyid stong pa mtha' dang bral ba thig le yongs rdzogs la phugs gtod cig sems nyid zung 'jug dbyer med rang snang lhug pas don gyi gnad khrol cig /sems nyid dbyings rig rnam dag smin mtshams 'od gsal la rlung rig gcud la bor cig / gang zhe na mgrin pa an tsam dgug /mig gyen la bzlog /rlung rang sor bcad/ yang lag pa g.yas pas mig mnan la/ mig g.yon pa nam mkha' la bltas pas ye shes kyi snang ba 'phel lo/ /sems nyid chos sku ma bcos rang byung rnal ma la phyi nang gcig tu gzhi phob cig

/sems nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs nyag gcig phyogs bral gcig pa las slar ma ldog cig /yang sprul skur song zhig /longs skur song zhig /chos skur song zhig /slar ma ldog cig /chos sku la ma 'dzin cig /slar ma ldog cig /longs sku la ma 'dzin cig /slar ma ldog cig /ces ngo sprad do/ athi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ sku gsum dal 'jug bla mas gnang*/ de nas gtor ma gtong*/ tshogs la longs spyod do/ /dpal sngags srung gi rgyal mos srungs shig /so phag shi thaṃ/ kha thaṃ/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ khi dbang gi phra tig ma dpe ma tshang ba slar mngon na 'dir 'jug / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (3)rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang*/ -PAGE 60--PAGE 61--PAGE 58-
